summary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 20th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 26, 2026. The meeting approved routine agenda items: financial statements for FY ending March 31, 2026, amendments to articles, a year-end dividend of JPY 1.890 per share, appointment of Sakurazaka Audit Corporation as auditor, and appointment of three corporate auditors. This is a standard governance update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. Watch for none; this is purely procedural.
